# laravel_cloud_ip_addresses (Data Source)

Lists Laravel Cloud egress IP addresses for firewall allowlisting.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Egress IP addresses to allow through an external firewall.
data "laravel_cloud_ip_addresses" "egress" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `region` (String) Limit the result to a single region, e.g. "us-east-1". Omit to return the addresses for every region. An unknown region is rejected by the API.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier.
- `ip_addresses` (List of String) Sorted IPv4 addresses and IPv6 CIDR ranges to allowlist. Covers every region unless `region` is set.
